title: Turkish Redcurrant Hangover Cure Crumble
description: A sweet and savory breakfast dish to cure your morning after, featuring Turkish delight and a crumble topping.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together Turkish Delight and Redcurrant Jam.
Roll out Crumble Topping and crumble into small pieces.
In a separate bowl, mix together eggs, milk, and butter.
Pour the egg mixture over the crumbled biscuits.
Add the crumbled biscuits to the Turkish Delight mixture and mix until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into a baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, topped with additional redcurrants if desired.
